scientific_integrity: One theorem, derived by an unrestricted suffix-extension proof, with exact enumerative checking as corroboration. No independent verification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only threshold-one three-color successor-contact updating on the transitively oriented tournament is covered; the proof does not extend automatically to directed graphs containing cycles or arbitrary acyclic digraphs.
Full text of the early foundational source was not accessible in its inspected archival representation; its published abstract and original submission date were verified.
The formula is unrestricted in n, while the two separately programmed exhaustive checks reach only 9 and 11 vertices, respectively.
Absolute historical priority is not certified and an independent external mathematical audit has not been performed.
title: Exact relaxation law for three-color successor dynamics on transitive tournaments
